mode: retrospective simulation over frozen artifacts; 0 API calls; nothing outside cascade_analysis_v1/ is written
disclosure: Routing rules, flag definitions and reference tiers were written by an implementer who had already seen P0-P4 outputs and GT. Flags use only generic conditions listed in the analysis brief (section 8) and fixed round-number defaults; they were not tuned per item. Because nothing is blind, every threshold result here is in-sample and descriptive.

reference_tiers._note: Danger reference is NOT the AI Hub source label. Tiers come from normalized_ground_truth_v1 human-verified fields.

hv_event_unanchored.definition: human_verified_observation confirms the observable event (e.g. wall crossing) but incident_presence_anchor is not_scored

diagnostic_source_label_only.definition: only a source-positive label plus selection approval; no human verification of incident presence

hard_normal_negative.definition: human-verified benign clip with confusable motion

danger_sets._note: D_anchor is the only human-anchored set. D_conservative treats every non-ambiguous source-positive assessment as must-surface. It is used only as a conservative safety CONSTRAINT (it can only add escalation), never as an accuracy truth.

representation_sensitive_flags.F_boundary: any camera: scene.boundary_semantics_available == false AND (scene.person_entry_observed OR scene.large_spatial_transition_observed OR scene.boundary_crossing truthy)
representation_sensitive_flags.F_multicam: task == multi_camera (synchronization and cross-camera identity unconfirmed by construction)
representation_sensitive_flags.F_interaction_lowconf: camera has >= 1 interaction record AND P1 category_confidence < 0.70
representation_sensitive_flags.F_disagree: (p_incident < 0.5 AND category not in {no_clear_incident}) OR (p_incident >= 0.5 AND category == no_clear_incident) OR category == uncertain
representation_sensitive_flags.F_lowconf: P1 adapter confidence < 0.60 OR P1 category_confidence < 0.50
representation_sensitive_flags.human_review_field: recorded and analysed, NOT used as a router (9/9 true in P1)

policies.P1_prob: NORMAL if p <= T_normal; DANGER if p >= T_danger; else SUSPICIOUS
policies.P2_prob_conf: NORMAL if p <= T_normal AND adapter confidence >= C_normal; DANGER if p >= T_danger; else SUSPICIOUS
policies.P3_safety_full: if any of {F_boundary, F_multicam, F_interaction_lowconf, F_disagree, F_lowconf, F_refusal}: not NORMAL (DANGER still allowed when p >= T_danger, else SUSPICIOUS); otherwise P1_prob

grid._note: T_normal 0.0 = never suppress; T_danger 1.01 = never direct-alert (everything non-NORMAL goes to P4). Probabilities are uncalibrated routing variables within this dataset only.

stage2.model: P4 GPT-6.1 Sol Vision (frozen p4-v1 outputs reused as if called)
stage2.human_fallback_rule: P4 refusal / error / missing -> HUMAN (none occurred)
stage2.call_unit: one P4 request per benchmark item (as actually run). Multi-camera items were one joint request; if any assessment of an item needs P4 the whole observed item cost is charged.

cost_policy.B: DANGER -> human immediately AND P4 background verification
cost_policy.formula_B: N*P1 + N*(suspicious_rate + danger_rate)*P4 (union per item, counted once)

cost_scenarios.label: scenario analysis — not a measured arrival rate

normal_source_scan.note: Pre-event portions of AI Hub abnormal-scenario videos are only CANDIDATE benign windows; they are staged, unverified and must be human-checked before use.
